name: API-Bench-HuggingfaceHub
description: A benchmark for evaluating models' ability to generate correct Hugging Face Hub API calls and related code snippets, including correct function usage, parameters, and integration patterns. It measures whether generated API usage is syntactically and semantically correct and whether it would succeed when executed against the Hub APIs. Useful for assessing models targeted at developer-assistance and API usage tasks.
reputation: Community adoption is limited; this is a user-contributed benchmark with modest visibility compared to larger, well-known code benchmarks.
